title: Build 17 admin publication remains pending
summary: The verified Learn Android 1.0.15 build 17 remains local and was not published to the admin download because the admin release flow requires a hosted HTTPS artifact and rejects this 171 MB APK above its 150 MB upload limit.

changes.detail: Recorded the publication outcome and preserved the pending release record without changing the currently configured admin download link.
